_about: This file documents the JSON content model consumed by scripts/build_cv.py and
doubles as a runnable example. To produce a CV, write your own content.json with
the same top-level keys (the build script ignores '_about' and '_fields'), then run:
Keep section labels at the ATS-safe defaults unless you have a reason not to.

Markup: wrap text in *...* to italicise it (foreign phrases such as *per se*, Latin names, publication titles). Skill items are auto-capitalised on the first letter for a consistent list; acronyms and iOS-style casing are preserved.

_fields.name: string (required). Renders large/bold at the top. NOT 'Curriculum Vitae'.
_fields.headline: string (optional). Target job title shown under the name; good for ATS title-matching.
_fields.contact: object: { phone, email, linkedin, website }, rendered in the body in this order. Use a SINGLE phone in the format matching the CV's country (+44 for a UK CV, +353 for an Irish CV). Location/city, nationality, and right-to-work notes are intentionally NOT shown - the generator ignores a 'location' or 'extra' field if present.
_fields.summary: string. 2-4 lines, ~50-150 words, no first-person pronouns. Tailored per job.
_fields.skills: either an object of grouped hard skills { 'Category': ['a','b'] } (renders one line per group) OR a flat array ['a','b'] (renders one comma line). Hard skills only.
_fields.experience: array of roles, most recent first: { title, company, location, start, end, bullets:[...] }. Dates as 'Month Year' (use 'Present' for current). 3-6 bullets recent, 1-3 older.
_fields.education: array, reverse chronological: { qualification, institution, start, end, detail }. Use UK classes (2:1, 2:2). 'detail' is an optional line (modules, A-levels, GCSE summary). For school qualifications, leave 'institution' and the dates blank (e.g. {qualification:'A-levels: Maths (A), Economics (B)'}) - they render cleanly as a single line; or fold A-levels/GCSEs into the degree's 'detail' line.
_fields.additional: array of extra sections in order: { heading, items:[...] } or { heading, text:'...' }. Optional 'bullets': true|false to force bullet vs comma rendering. Use for Certifications, Languages, Memberships.
_fields.config: object (optional) of formatting knobs to tune two-page fit. See defaults below; smaller margins/sizes fit more. 'labels' overrides the four standard section headings (keep ATS-safe). 'accent_hex' (e.g. '1F3864') tints headings; null = black (safest).

headline: Senior Product Marketing Manager
